description: Internal automated readiness rubric, not the sponsor's judging weights or an official competition score. The three group labels retain the literal bounty capabilities. Clean-slot bidding is demonstrated through posted-price choice using supplied forecast evidence, not an auction or measured execution emissions. Compare scores only within the same rubric version.

changes: Keeps the literal bounty capabilities and 100 total points: A job router that shows carbon saved 40; Agents that bid for the cleanest slots 40; A live map of where to train right now 20.
Retains the bounty capability Agents that bid for the cleanest slots. Its implementation uses posted-price choice with forecast evidence; it does not require an auction or Bid abstraction.
Retires the unaffordable-bid check because jobs no longer have auction budgets; adds direct cleaner-slot selection, remaining-capacity, utility-commitment and transfer-deadline requirements.

Clean-slot capability weights are 8 cleaner eligible choice, 6 protected energy, 6 remaining GPUs, 4 utility commitment, 4 transfer deadline, 6 partial execution and 6 browser selection. Version 1 weights were four auction/execution cases at 10 each.
Reporting retains equal-work, equal-ending-storage and unknown-evidence safeguards, and now checks the separate modeled dollar headline.
